verses.sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच। धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सवः। मामकः पाण्डवाश्चैव किमकुर्वत सञ्जय।।1.1।।
verses.tr: dhṛitarāṣṭra uvācha | dharma-kṣhetre kuru-kṣhetre samavetā yuyutsavaḥ | māmakaḥ pāṇḍavāścaiva kimakurvata sañjaya ||1.1||
verses.wm: dhṛitarāṣṭraḥ uvācha—Dhritarashtra said; dharma-kṣhetre—the land of dharma; kuru-kṣhetre—at Kurukshetra; samavetāḥ—having gathered; yuyutsavaḥ—desiring to fight; māmakaḥ—my sons; pāṇḍavaḥ—the sons of Pandu; cha—and; eva—certainly; kim—what; akurvata—did they do; sañjaya—Sanjay
verses.en: Dhritarashtra said: O Sanjaya, what did my sons and the sons of Pandu do when they gathered together on the field of dharma at Kurukshetra, eager for battle?

verses.sa: सञ्जय उवाच। दृष्ट्वा तु पाण्डवानीकं व्यूढं दुर्योधनस्तदा। आचार्यमुपसङ्गम्य राजा वचनमब्रवीत्।।1.2।।
verses.tr: sañjaya uvācha | dṛiṣṭvā tu pāṇḍavānīkaṁ vyūḍhaṁ duryodhanastadā | āchāryamupasaṅgamya rājā vachanamabravīt ||1.2||
verses.wm: sañjayaḥ uvācha—Sanjay said; dṛiṣṭvā—on observing; tu—but; pāṇḍava-anīkam—the Pandava army; vyūḍham—standing in a military formation; duryodhanaḥ—King Duryodhan; tadā—then; āchāryam—teacher; upasaṅgamya—approached; rājā—the king; vachanam—words; abravīt—spoke
verses.en: Sanjaya said: On observing the Pandava army, King Duryodhan approached his teacher Drona and spoke these words:

verses.sa: पश्यैतां पाण्डुपुत्राणामाचार्य महतीं चमूम। व्यूढां द्रुपदपुत्रेण तव शिष्येण धीमता।।1.3।।
verses.tr: paśhyaitāṁ pāṇḍuputrāṇām āchārya mahatīṁ chamūm | vyūḍhāṁ drupadaputreṇa tava śhiṣhyeṇa dhīmatā ||1.3||
verses.wm: paśhya—behold; etām—this; pāṇḍu-putrāṇām—of the sons of Pandu; āchārya—respected teacher; mahatīm—mighty; chamūm—army; vyūḍhām—arrayed; drupada-putreṇa—son of Drupad; tava—by your; śhiṣhyeṇa—disciple; dhīmatā—intelligent
verses.en: Behold, O teacher, the mighty army of the sons of Pandu, led by your intelligent disciple, the son of Drupad!

verses.sa: अत्र शूरा महेष्वासा भीमार्जुनसमा युधि। युयुधानो विराटश्च द्रुपदश्च महारथः।।1.4।।
verses.tr: atra śhūrā maheṣhvāsā bhīmārjunasamā yudhi | yuyudhāno virāṭaśca drupadaśca mahārathaḥ ||1.4||
verses.wm: atra—here; śhūrāḥ—powerful warriors; mahā-iṣhvāsāḥ—great bowmen; bhīma-arjuna-samāḥ—equal to Bheem and Arjun; yudhi—in battle; yuyudhānaḥ—Yuyudhan; virāṭaḥ—Virat; cha—and; drupadaḥ—Drupad; cha—also; mahā-rathaḥ—great warrior
verses.en: Here are mighty warriors like Bheem and Arjun, and Virat, Drupad and Yuyudhan, all great warriors.

verses.sa: धृष्टकेतुश्चेकितानः काशिराजश्च वीर्यवान्। पुरुजित्कुन्तिभोजश्च शैब्यश्च नरपुङ्गवः।।1.5।।
verses.tr: dhṛiṣṭaketuśhcekītānaḥ kāśhirājaśca vīryavān | purujit kuntibhojaśca śhaibyaśca nara-puṅgavaḥ ||1.5||
verses.wm: dhṛiṣṭaketuḥ—Dhrishtaketu; chekītānaḥ—Chekitan; kāśhirājaḥ—Kashiraj; cha—and; vīryavān—heroic; purujit—Purujit; kuntibhojaḥ—Kuntibhoj; cha—and; śhaibyaḥ—Shaibya; cha—and; nara-puṅgavaḥ—best of men
verses.en: And here are Dhrishtaketu, Chekitan, Kashiraj, Purujit, Kuntibhoj, and Shaibya - all heroes.
